bias.en: Bullish trend · overbought, pausing under the record
bias.zh: 多头趋势 · 超买，于纪录高点下方整理

read.en: Palantir eased 0.2% on Oct 13 to $208.67, holding just under the Oct 12 record of $212.94. It is above all its rising averages: the 5-day ($203.9), 10-day ($196.7), 30-day ($184.6), 100-day ($155.4) and 200-day ($152.5). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 6, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Sep 21 ($193.3), and RSI is 76, overbought.
read.zh: Palantir 10月13日小跌 0.2%，收于 $208.67，紧贴 10月12日创下的 $212.94 纪录高点。股价位于所有上行均线上方：5 日（$203.9）、10 日（$196.7）、30 日（$184.6）、100 日（$155.4）和 200 日均线（$152.5）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线上方，抛物线 SAR 自 9月21日起看多（$193.3），RSI 为 76，处于超买。

read.en: Nothing broke: the stock paused below the $213 record. A close above it would target the round numbers at $220, then $230. Support is $204 (5-day average and Oct 8 high), then $197 (10-day average) and $193 (Parabolic SAR), with the Sep 24 high at $194.7 just above the SAR.
read.zh: 关键位均未被突破：股价在 $213 纪录高点下方整理。若收盘站上该位置，目标看整数关口 $220，再看 $230。支撑为 $204（5 日均线及 10月8日高点），其次 $197（10 日均线）和 $193（抛物线 SAR），9月24日高点 $194.7 位于 SAR 略上方。
